name: EmbodiedBench — Manipulation v3
protocol: EmbodiedBench v3 EB-Manipulation fixed 228-instance default protocol, detection boxes enabled, task-specific demonstrations, 15-step limit, temperature 0. Other EmbodiedBench environments are excluded.

explanation.en: Each episode receives binary credit from its simulator-defined goal condition; the score is the percentage of 228 successful episodes.
explanation.zh: 每个 episode 按 simulator 定义的目标条件获得二元分数，最终得分是 228 个 episode 的成功比例。

summary.en: EmbodiedBench Manipulation measures whether a vision-language agent can complete simulated robot-arm manipulation through closed-loop actions.
summary.zh: EmbodiedBench Manipulation 测试视觉语言 agent 能否通过闭环动作完成模拟机械臂操作任务。

task_format.en: The agent observes 500x500 simulator images and issues up to 15 seven-dimensional Franka-arm actions to complete one of 228 tasks.
task_format.zh: agent 观察 500×500 simulator 图像，并发出最多 15 个七维 Franka 机械臂动作来完成 228 个 task 之一。
